items.title: Bank Stocks Drop From Record Highs Ahead of Fed Meeting
items.summary: Goldman’s stock, which fell 4.6%, was on track for its worst performance in two months.  Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, and Bank of America—all of which hit records this month, too—dropped 3.4%, 2.3%, and 1.2%, respectively on Wednesday.  Citi was down 3.3%, and Wells Fargo dropped 2%.

items.title: Space Industry Needs Economic Infrastructure Says Nebex CEO
items.summary: Tejpaul Bhatia, the CEO of Nebex, said that his company, which is aimed at building a financial operating system for the space industry, saw an economic gap in the growth of space travel as more money is put into the growth of the commercial space industry. Bhatia compared the potential of a space economy to the role of American Express and Wells Fargo at the beginning of the railroad industry.
